description.en: The IDs of the protected assets to attach. The value is in the \[**"XX1","XX2",...**] format.

description.zh: 绑定的防护对象组，使用[**"group1","group2",……**]格式。
description.en: The protected object groups to attach. The value is in the \[**"group1","group2",...**] format.

description.zh: 绑定的防护对象，使用[**"XX1","XX2",……**]格式。
description.en: The protected objects to attach. The value is in the \[**"XX1","XX2",...**] format.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
